n_instances/n_features not recorded as numbers: only '#train/test' (e.g. 23k/10k) and #C/#B/#M column counts are printed (supp p.1)
Metric mixes F1, macro-F1, accuracy, R2 across datasets; no single-metric per-dataset table exists
notes: Tabular data generator (CTGAN; TVAE also proposed as a challenger), not an oversampler. No SMOTE. Evaluation = likelihood fitness (Lsyn, Ltest) on 7 simulated datasets and machine learning efficacy on 8 real datasets. Main paper Table 2 (p.8) gives only averages; per-dataset results in Supplementary Table 3 (rendered image, supp p.3). best_other is TVAE (main comparator) per instruction; ablation Table 3 p.9 reports % change on real classification datasets. Code: https://github.com/DAI-Lab/CTGAN; benchmark https://github.com/DAI-Lab/SDGym (not fetched).
